import { ServiceProvider } from '@guren/core'
import { Comment } from '../Models/Comment.js'
import { CommentPolicy } from '../Policies/CommentPolicy.js'

/** Registers CommentPolicy with the gate for Comment records. */
export default class CommentPolicyProvider extends ServiceProvider {
  register(): void {}

  // The framework's own provider binds the gate during registration, so this
  // runs in boot(): make('gate') throws before that.
  boot(): void {
    this.container.make('gate').policy(Comment, CommentPolicy)
  }
}
